page.title: Feature your properties on the MLS!
page.body:
Feature your properties on the MLS!​​


Show It First, Sell It Fast:
Keep Your Listing Fresh in Other Agents’ Minds!
With PropertyList MLS featuring, your properties will skyrocket to the top of search results and secure a guaranteed spot on the first page. Maximise your exposure to agents who are actively searching for their clients, and get your listings noticed faster!


Featured Listings: Your featured listings will be showcased for 3 days (72 hours). When your listing is featured, it will appear at the top of the relevant location and is guaranteed a spot on the first page of that town!
Target Like a Pro: Unlike regular advertising, featuring allows for precise targeting while hunting. This ensures your listings reach agents with qualified buyers, increasing viewing and offer possibilities. .

Simple Steps to Featuring:

  1. Navigate to “My Listings”.
  2. Open any of your direct listing and click the button at the top named: “FEATURE”.
  3. Select the “Feature on MLS” button.
  4. Click “Submit”. (Existing account credit will be used, or a payment method can be entered). PropertyList is a secure platform ensuring your transactions are safe. Learn more here.
 
That’s it! Your property is now prominently displayed on the MLS, grabbing immediate agent attention.
ONLY 20 SPOTS AVAILABLE PER TOWN!


Notifications:

You will receive both an in-app notification and an email just before your listing is unfeatured, so you can feature it again for maximum exposure. This ensures that each member has the opportunity to feature their properties in each area.

Benefits of Featuring:

  • Increased Agent Visibility: More agents see your listings, leading to more viewings and potential offers.
  • Psychological Recall: By showcasing your listing ahead of others, each search increases view counts, ensuring your property remains top-of-mind for agents.
  • Faster Sales: Increased agent interest translates to quicker sales, reducing listing time and boosting your earnings.
  • Enhanced Reputation: Establish yourself as a proactive agent who delivers results for clients.

Enable Property Featuring for Staff Accounts

To allow a staff account to feature listings using agency credits, select the “Can Feature” option within the settings for that specific staff member.


Bonus Tip:

Track your listing’s exposure and views within the property page to gain valuable insights and optimise your featuring strategy.


Remember: Featuring is a powerful tool, but it works best alongside a well-crafted MLS listing with high-quality photos and clear descriptions. Combine these strategies to fast-track your listings’ success!


Subscription Model Limitations: With our monthly paid subscription plans, you receive credits for platform use. While these credits offer great flexibility, there are limitations on featuring properties to prevent platform spamming. You can feature up to 3 listings at a time. If you wish to feature more listings, you can purchase additional credits. The Unlimited Plan is highly desirable because it includes unlimited access to all other extras, such as “Open a Direct Lead” from the globally advertised public portal.
